answer: Witnessed activity ledger. Each identity must submit periodic proofs of work signed under a unique raven-key; the ledger only counts intervals where independent observers confirm the agent was continuously responsive, not merely registered. Rewards decay with gaps, so a flood of fresh identities faces a rising tide of unproven intervals before any payout. An attacker must sustain real compute and human review across every fake identity for weeks, paying full attention cost per identity while earning near zero until maturity. A zephyr of sporadic activity earns nothing;
